newsitem.title: UK: Increased demand supports UK grain futures.
newsitem.headline: Increased demand supports UK grain futures.

text.p: UK grain futures closed higher on Tuesday following an increase in demand and weaker currency.
"There has been a slight increase in demand which has supported prices and sterling has been a bit weak. But apart from that nothing exciting is happening," said a trader.
Traders on the cash market reported a slowing in business as the futures rose.

"A rising futures market always frightens the buyers off, but very few people are willing to buy foward at the moment because they have been caught out by falling prices too often lately," said one trader.
Wheat futures closed 0.20 to 0.45 stg up after trading 409 lots while barley was 0.10 stg higher on 137 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures closed unchanged and tradeless.
On the UK cash markets no business was reported in the fob sector while delivered trade was light and mainly for nearby material.
